title: Three-Month Comprehensive Outcomes of Topography-Guided LASIK Versus Keratorefractive Lenticule Extraction (KLEx): A Prospective Contralateral Study
indication: myopia with or without astigmatism; eligibility as stated in Methods (preoperative SEQ -2.00 to -9.00 D, sphere -2.00 to -8.00 D, cylinder up to -3.00 D, age 22-50 years); randomized contralateral design, 34 patients

groups.description: Topography-guided femtosecond LASIK (WaveLight EX500 with Contoura/Phorcides planning, FS200 flap 100 um); one eye per patient assigned at random
SMILE (VisuMax 500 kHz, 120 um cap, nomogram-adjusted treatment); contralateral eye of the same 34 patients

series.notes: mean ± SD (Tab3 footnote); 34 eyes per arm, no loss to follow-up reported
mean ± SD (Tab3 footnote); 34 eyes per arm, no loss to follow-up reported

exclusions.reason: same preoperative SEQ as Tab3 R3, which is cited for the whole series
refraction not measured at 1 day (visual acuity only)

exclusions.what: Fig. 1d-1f (proportions within the SEQ target, attempted-versus-achieved regression, SEQ stability)
exclusions.reason: proportions and attempted-versus-achieved fits are not admissible

notes: Randomized contralateral trial: TG-LASIK and SMILE are two standard techniques compared without an investigational agent, so both groups are control with their own procedure contexts.
Target recorded plano: the Results report predictability as within ±0.13 D of the SEQ target and the Discussion states the same measure as within ±0.13 D of plano.
Method recorded manifest: manifest refraction is the only refraction examination named in Methods; refractive outcomes were measured at 1 week, 1 month and 3 months.
ANCOVA with age and sex covariates produced the p-values; the Tab3 footnote states that tabulated values are mean ± standard deviation.
SMILE eyes received prednisolone for two additional weeks.
Cylinder, Km and CCT (Tab3), contrast sensitivity (Tab2), higher-order aberrations (Tab4), epithelial thickness (Tab5-6), corneal biomechanics and visual acuity are reported but not extracted.
Negative SEQ cells (Tab1 R5, Tab3 R3) print a thin space (U+2009) between the minus sign and the digits; the frozen builder's number parser does not read such cells.
